title: Writer Assistant Core implementation readiness and first runtime slice plan
goal: Promote Writer Assistant Core as the next roadmap frontier after the completed Phase 7 Project Workspace Foundation and prepare the first safe runtime slice through implementation readiness, context planning, schema alignment, OMI candidate-first lifecycle boundaries, and acceptance criteria.
why_now: The published Phase 7 parent sequence PHASE7-IMPL-001 through PHASE7-IMPL-010 is complete. Writer Assistant Core is the next product direction, but implementation must start with readiness and context planning before extraction, candidate creation, model calls, UI changes, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation.

include: Roadmap/status publication of PHASE8-IMPL-001 as the active Writer Assistant Core parent.
Conservative child-task sequence T001 through T007.
Current code, storage, and test inventory planning.
Context collection planning before context tools run.

Candidate schema alignment for characters, aliases, organizations, locations, objects, scenes, events/actions, timeline/causality notes, relationships, plot threads, open questions, continuity issues, contradictions, annotations, evidence, and provenance.
OMI candidate-first lifecycle and future owner-controlled promotion boundaries.
First runtime slice selection and acceptance criteria after context collection.
exclude: Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
Apply-promotion, OMI candidate promotion, or memory/canon mutation.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset manifests, model artifacts, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, and Dramatica analysis.

quality_notes: T001 publishes the parent and child plan only.
T002 publishes the context collection plan at docs/roadmap/context/PHASE8-IMPL-001-context-collection-plan.md.
T003 produced docs/roadmap/context/PHASE8-IMPL-001-targeted-context-report.md using direct file/source inspection only.
T004 selected Writer Assistant Core candidate schema constants plus source-level/contract tests as the first runtime slice.
Runtime extraction, candidate creation, model calls, UI changes, apply-promotion, and memory/canon mutation are excluded from T001 through T004.

validation.notes: Pytest is not run for T001 unless runtime code or tests were accidentally changed.

safety_notes: No generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
All extracted or inferred story knowledge remains candidate-only until explicit owner review and later owner-controlled promotion.
OMI remains the central review and future promotion layer.
Promotion records remain audit-only until future apply-promotion exists.
Roadmap truth remains roadmap_index.yaml, implementation_status.md, task records, enrichment JSON, and validation docs.
deferred_work: T003 direct-inspection context collection is complete and recorded in docs/roadmap/context/PHASE8-IMPL-001-targeted-context-report.md.
Runtime extraction, candidate creation, typed OMI expansion, backend routes, frontend UI, and first slice implementation are deferred to later children.
Apply-promotion and memory/canon mutation remain future-only.
Model/Ollama integration remains future-only and requires separate authorization.
